patches_modified.name: Add AMOLED Theme
patches_modified.description: Adds a selectable Pure Black AMOLED theme using Gboard's native color_black theme package, without replacing Dark, Light, System Auto, or Dynamic Color.

patches_modified.name: Allow Modified APK
patches_modified.description: Bypasses internal signature check to allow custom APK execution.

patches_modified.name: Block Telemetry
patches_modified.description: Disables background metrics dispatch, event logging, daily pings, and crash reporting.

patches_modified.name: Clone Gboard
patches_modified.description: Changes the package name by appending a dot and custom suffix (defaults to 'kveld') to allow installing Gboard alongside the original application.

patches_modified.name: DPI Resource Slimmer
patches_modified.description: Strips unselected screen density resource directories from res/ (e.g. drawable-mdpi, drawable-hdpi, mipmap-xhdpi). Density-independent resources (nodpi, anydpi) and orphan resources are safely preserved.

patches_modified.name: Disable Diagnostics
patches_modified.description: Disables Google's diagnostic and recovery telemetry.

patches_modified.name: Disable Google Primes
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes Google Primes performance profiling, jank monitoring, native crash sidecars, and background telemetry threads.

patches_modified.name: Disable MDD Background Sync
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes Mobile Data Download (MDD) periodic background synchronization, automated polling, and prefetch worker tasks while preserving on-demand and user-requested downloads.

patches_modified.name: Disable Remote Configuration
patches_modified.description: Disables periodic remote experiment flag synchronization and background updates.

patches_modified.name: Disable Superpacks Eager Sync
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes eager background Superpacks synchronization during application startup, eliminating unnecessary disk sweeps and network polling while preserving on-demand pack downloads.

patches_modified.name: Disable Tenor Share Tracking
patches_modified.description: Disables Tenor GIF selection and share tracking telemetry.

patches_modified.name: Disable WorkManager
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes background WorkManager initialization, database creation, and periodic maintenance workers.

patches_modified.name: Enable Access Points Menu Redesign
patches_modified.description: Enables the redesigned access points menu bar and customization panel (Panel V2).

patches_modified.name: Enable Key Shape Selection
patches_modified.description: Enables the key border shape selection UI (Default, Semi-rounded, Round) in theme customization.

patches_modified.name: Force Incognito Mode
patches_modified.description: Forces Gboard to always operate in incognito mode (disabling personalized learning and persistent input logging) while keeping clipboard functionality enabled.

patches_modified.name: Hardened Intent Security
patches_modified.description: Enables Gboard internal external intent protection against unauthorized intent hijacking.

patches_modified.name: Locale Resource Slimmer
patches_modified.description: Strips unselected language translation directories from res/ (e.g. values-*, raw-*, xml-*). Base fallback resources with no language qualifiers are always preserved.

patches_modified.name: PNG Asset Optimizer
patches_modified.description: Losslessly recompresses PNG assets with maximum zlib compression and strips non-rendering metadata chunks (pHYs, tEXt, tIME) while preserving 9-patch structures and pixel accuracy.

patches_modified.name: Resource Slimmer
patches_modified.description: Strips embedded third-party license text, onboarding tutorial Lottie animations, promotional GIFs, and APK root metadata/junk files.

patches_added.name: Hill Climb Racing Example Overlay Addon
patches_added.description:
Example overlay addon for Hill Climb Racing (com.fingersoft.hillclimb), used together with UniPatches Universal Overlay.
        It adds six safe, mock-only app-specific preview modules to the shared overlay: A
        - Add Coins
        - Add Gems
        - Add Paints 
        - Vehicle Selection
        - Stage Selection
        - Garage Selection. 
        All these six module options are enabled by default and can be disabled independently. 
        
        Module settings and Preview actions are session-only; this example addon never reads or changes currencies, vehicles, stages, garage state, purchases, save files, or game bytecode.

patches_removed.name: Hill Climb Racing Overlay Example (Experimental)
patches_removed.description: Safe app-specific overlay example for Hill Climb Racing (com.fingersoft.hillclimb). Select one or more preview modules, patch, then use their Settings and Preview controls in the shared overlay UI. Values are session-only and reset when the app process restarts. This contributor example demonstrates explicit launcher injection, styled settings popups, checkbox lists, and one-shot actions; it never alters currencies, unlocks, purchases, saves, or game bytecode. Do not combine with Universal Overlay Patch, because both patches install the same shared overlay runtime.
